get_warp_dimensions_sorted: get the top k warp dimensions by standard deviation from a PyTorch embedding tensor
get_warp_dimensions_all: get all warp dimension indices from a PyTorch embedding tensor without sorting
visualize_warp_with_bounds: visualize warp embeddings by selecting dimensions and normalizing with custom min and max bounds
visualize_warp_normalized: visualize warp embeddings by selecting dimensions and auto-normalizing values to 0-1 range
visualize_warp_abs: visualize warp embeddings by taking absolute values and clamping output to 0-1 range
